narrative: The technology sector is buzzing with developments, from NVIDIA's legal challenges to new AI models from Anthropic and OpenAI. Geothermal energy is gaining traction, while concerns about AI's environmental impact and security vulnerabilities remain prominent. NASA continues its ambitious space exploration missions, highlighting scientific progress.

highlights.title: The race is on to sue Nvidia
highlights.whyItMatters: Nvidia’s stock slid more than 4% after its board opened an investigation into Jensen Huang’s relationship with a suspected Chinese spy, and one securities law expert says the company’s earlier insistence that it was all “normal” could turn into a very expensive problem.

highlights.title: DCU shake-up: James Gunn and Peter Safran out post-merger
highlights.whyItMatters: Producer and former Kevin Feige protege Jeremy Latcham will replace Gunn and Safran.

highlights.title: MSI’s refurbished QD-OLED gaming monitor is on sale for under $300
highlights.whyItMatters: One of the best upgrades you can make to your PC gaming setup is an OLED monitor.

highlights.title: Man who lost $308,000 on sports bets sues Kalshi for offering illegal gambling
highlights.whyItMatters: Lawsuit demands Kalshi return losses because online betting is illegal in Washington.

highlights.title: The global pledge to use AI for climate good is a cruel joke
highlights.whyItMatters: At this point, reading through the latest splashy pledge to use AI for the good of the environment feels like downing a nonalcoholic beer.
